summary: Frontend-only validation completed on public preview URL across routes, navigation, dialogs, forms, filters, links, responsiveness, and reduced-motion behavior.

ui_bugs.issue: Unknown routes show a custom 404 page instead of returning to home automatically.

Invalid/empty field feedback is mostly native browser tooltip (required/pattern), while `[data-testid='*-error']` is often not rendered. This reduces consistent accessibility/automation-visible validation messaging.

action_items: Align unknown-route behavior with requirement (auto-redirect to `/` or update requirement to keep custom 404 page).
Add explicit, consistent inline validation messaging for empty/invalid form fields (not only native browser bubbles).
Re-run focused UI retest for 404 behavior and form validation visibility after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: `Service` component uses `services.find(...)` without null guard; an unexpected/mismatched route param could crash when reading `service.id`.
Form validation mixes native HTML constraint validation and custom error state; this creates inconsistent error UX and testability.
Initial image audit using `img.complete` alone can misclassify lazy images; strict check (`complete && currentSrc && naturalWidth===0`) showed no broken images.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed multiple Playwright runs against public preview URL. Core flows pass: all 10 routes direct-load, header/mobile nav, privacy dialog, service/location prefill, stories/resources filters, article dialog, checklist fetch, location keyboard tabs, outbound links, responsive widths 360/390/768/1024/1440/1920 (no horizontal overflow), reduced motion visibility, and strict broken-image audit (0 broken). Console only shows preview harness/report endpoint request-abort noise; no app runtime exceptions observed.
rca of the issue: 1) Unknown route behavior: App.jsx defines `path='*'` custom 404 element with Return Home link, so it intentionally does not auto-redirect. Repro: open `/unknown-route-xyz`; observe `[data-testid='not-found-title']`. Mitigation: replace wildcard element with `<Navigate to='/' replace />` if requirement is redirect. 2) Validation message inconsistency: inputs use `required` + `pattern`; browser blocks submit before custom `submit()` logic, so `booking-error/contact-error` may not render for many invalid states. Repro: open booking dialog and click submit empty/invalid; review doesn’t open, but inline custom error often absent. Mitigation: either rely fully on custom validation (`noValidate` + controlled checks) or provide explicit aria-live error text per field.
